svg.aria-label: Left: on Baird's counterexample, the largest value estimate on a log scale against the number of updates; off-policy semi-gradient TD grows without bound, past 10 to the 12 after 10,000 steps, while the same updates on-policy shrink towards zero. Right: the return per episode, smoothed over 20 episodes, against environment steps for DQN on CartPole, three seeds each, for full DQN, DQN without a target network, and DQN without experience replay
svg.text: DQN on CartPole, three seeds each
